newsitem.title: CHINA: China's end-Feb forex reserves exceed $110 billion.
newsitem.headline: China's end-Feb forex reserves exceed $110 billion.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves exceeded $110 billion by the end of February, the Financial News said on Monday, quoting central bank governor Dai Xianglong.
Dai forecast economic growth this year at 8-9 percent and inflation below six percent, the newspaper said.
China's foreign exchange reserves reached $105 billion at the end of 1996, up $31.5 billion from the beginning of last year, official figures show.
The central bank has said it expects the country's foreign exchange reserves to grow by at least $20 billion this year.
